notes: IMDuelHook uses constructor arguments (IPoolManager manager_, IChessEngine engine_, Currency imd_, uint256 turnBlocks_) in that order: $poolManager, the already deployed ChessEngineV5 at 0xc21788f704a8b9456f7391a01d8a3d95be215a27, IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, and 3. IMDuelToken has no constructor parameters and provides the standard IMDuel (IMDUEL) token with 18 decimals and plain ERC-20 transfers. Supply and allocations are governed by the separately versioned launch policy, not this manifest. The factory deploys the token and hook and initializes the IMDUEL/IMD pool atomically. afterInitialize learns IMDUEL from the first pool, which must pair IMD, and makes it the main duel; later duels must pair IMD or IMDUEL. All enabled callbacks require the PoolManager. There are no liquidity callbacks restricting the factory's fee collection. The hook accepts the listed LP fee 12500 and tick spacing 60 in either token order. initialPrice is the required one-to-one sqrtPriceX96 reference; the deployer derives the actual opening price from the launch policy and token order. The hook has no owner, admin, pause, upgrade path or backend signer. Its 0.75% swap fee is additional to the 1.25% LP fee, with no opening surcharge and no price reads: 0.65% fills both teams' pots, 0.325% from each trade side into that token's pot; 0.1% is taken in IMDUEL wherever the pool holds it and owed to the fixed burn destination 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead. Anyone may call withdraw for that destination to send the tokens there; this does not reduce ERC-20 totalSupply. In duels without IMDUEL, the 0.1% is taken in IMD into the main duel's IMD pot. Fees mint PoolManager ERC-6909 claims; no hook payout transfers occur during swaps. Every swap that pays a hook fee emits URC-2 HookSwap with 7500 pips. Partial fills revert. Fees round down; pot contributions stop at the uint128 pot cap. Every swap bids for the team of the token received. A new top bid must pay over 10% more; strength is the amount received as a share of that team's pot, capped at 90%. Bids stay open for 3 blocks; a later swap plays the move through the engine using the closing block's hash. A late first bid gets a full window. Only checkmate pays the mating move's owner, in the loser's token: the minimum of 25% of the losing pot, twice that move's bid payment, and that game's trade contributions to the losing pot. Donations and protocol slices do not count toward that inflow cap. Captures, checks, draws and timeout moves pay nothing; unused pots carry over. Rewards are recorded in owed; anyone may withdraw to the beneficiary, or the beneficiary may use withdrawTo, leaving 1 wei owed. Bid attribution uses a valid address in hookData (20 packed or 32 ABI-encoded bytes), falling back to tx.origin; relayed trades without valid hookData credit the relayer. The closing block's builder can influence its hash. Unavailable hashes reopen the bid without a beneficiary. Engine failure tries a seeded legal move at zero strength, then a draw if that fails; insufficient engine gas reverts. A side silent for 600 seconds can receive a zero-strength timeout move triggered by the other team's swap. Per-address stats and players track main-duel play for display only and never determine rewards or limits.
